title: Communication Dated February 15, 1937 From J. Sanft Applying For Position As Interpreter

page_data.en:
P.M. 2

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ... 7567
S.I. Special Branch Division,
REPORT
Date February 23, 1937

Subject Communication dated February 15, 1937 from J. SANFT
applying for position as interpreter.

Made by D.J. Pitts. Forwarded by J. Boyne O.I.J.

With reference to the contents of the attached communi-
cation dated February 15, 1937 in which one J. SANFT applies
for a position as interpreter, I have to report that this
gentleman was interviewed at Police Headquarters during the
afternoon of February 23, 1937 when the following information
was obtained:-

Jacques SANFT, Spanish Jew, was born at Constantinople
on August 14, 1877, both his parents being Spaniards. He
was educated in Constantinople and in Alexandria, Egypt.
Later he spent two years in Paris, where he studied French
whilst working in a factory there. He worked in a store
belonging to his uncle in Constantinople for some six years,
and in 1900 came to China, where he has been ever since.

During his residence in China, the greater part of which
has been spent in Shanghai, Sanft has been employed as follows:

1) 1900 until 1903...with the French Municipal Council,
conducting a canteen for the French troops. (reference
produced).

2) 1903 until 1909...with the Eclipse Film Co., an organis-
ation which is now defunct. (no reference).

3) 1909 until 1911...with the Poole Illustrated Lecture
Company, taking films of Chinese life in Canton, Hankow,
Peiping, Hangchow, Swatow, Amoy, Soochow, etc. (reference
produced).

4) 1911 until 1915...night clerk at the Palace Hotel
(reference produced).

5) 1915 until 1926...manager of the Hongkew and Empire
Theatres under the ownership of the now defunct Ramos
Amusement Co. (reference produced).

日期：1937 年 2 月 23 日

事由：J. SANFT 于 1937 年 2 月 15 日来函申请翻译职位。

由 D.J. Pitts 拟写。经 J. Boyne O.I.J. 转呈。

关于所附 1937 年 2 月 15 日来函的内容，信中一位名为 J. SANFT 的人士申请翻译职位，兹报告如下：本人与该绅士于 1937 年 2 月 23 日下午在警察总局进行了面谈，并获取了以下信息：

Jacques SANFT，西班牙籍犹太人，1877 年 8 月 14 日出生于君士坦丁堡，其父母均为西班牙人。他在君士坦丁堡和埃及亚历山大港接受教育。后来他在巴黎度过了两年，期间在一家工厂做工并学习法语。他在君士坦丁堡其叔叔拥有的一家商店工作了约六年，并于 1900 年来到中国，此后一直居住于此。

Sanft 在华居住期间，大部分时间在上海度过，其受雇经历如下：

1) 1900 年至 1903 年……受雇于法公董局，为法国军队经营食堂。（已提供推荐信）。

2) 1903 年至 1909 年……受雇于 Eclipse 电影公司，该机构现已倒闭。（无推荐信）。

3) 1909 年至 1911 年……受雇于 Poole 图解讲座公司，在广州、汉口、北平、杭州、汕头、厦门、苏州等地拍摄反映中国人生活的影片。（已提供推荐信）。

4) 1911 年至 1915 年……任 Palace Hotel（礼查饭店）夜班职员（已提供推荐信）。

5) 1915 年至 1926 年……任虹口大戏院和 Empire Theatre（帝国大戏院）经理，这两家剧院隶属于现已倒闭的 Ramos 娱乐公司。（已提供推荐信）。

6) 1926 (March until September)... Salesman with Messrs.
Hall and Holtz (no reference).
7) 1926 until 1936... salesman in the Wine Department of
Messrs. Hirsbrunner (reference produced).
8) Since March 1936 Sanft has been selling wines and like
beverages on his own account.
All references produced speak of Sanft in high terms,
leaving little doubt as to his honesty and ability in the
positions he held.
He has previously made applications to the French Police
for employment as an interpreter, but up to the present has
been unsuccessful in his quest.
He was examined cursorily in this office and he displayed
a good command in spoken English, French, Russian, Spanish,
German, Italian, Portuguese, but he admitted himself that
his knowledge of the written languages was almost negligible.
No attempt was made to test him in Arabic, Greek or Turkish.
Sanft is at present residing at Apartment No. 5, No. 375
Avenue du Roi Albert. His telephone number is 73611.
He has no police record in either the International
Settlement or the French Concession.

6) 1926 年（3 月至 9 月）……任 Hall and Holtz 商行销售员（无推荐信）。
7) 1926 年至 1936 年……任 Hirsbrunner 商行酒类部销售员（已提供推荐信）。
8) 自 1936 年 3 月起，Sanft 自行经营葡萄酒及类似饮料的销售业务。
所有提供的推荐信均对 Sanft 评价甚高，对其在所任职务中的诚实和能力几乎毫无疑问。
他此前曾向法国巡捕房申请担任翻译职务，但至今未获成功。
在本办公室对其进行了简略考核，他展现出良好的英语、法语、俄语、西班牙语、德语、意大利语、葡萄牙语口语能力，但他自己承认，其书面语言知识几乎微不足道。
未尝试测试其阿拉伯语、希腊语或土耳其语能力。
Sanft 目前居住在阿尔伯特王路 375 号 5 室公寓。其电话号码为 73611。
他在公共租界或法租界均无犯罪记录。

375 avenue du Roi Albert,
King Albert apts. Apt. No. 5
Shanghai, February 15th. 1937

Shanghai Municipal Council,
Police Department,
Shanghai.

Gentlemen:-

As a desirable resident of Shanghai for the last
36 years in the business world and with unquestionable referen-
ces on account of the present day changing conditions and pos-
sible present or future openings for a qualified interpreter,
I beg to lay for your consideration my application for such a
position, whole or part time.

I speak fluently 8 of the most principal languages
namely:- Spanish, English, French, German, Greek, Turkish, Russian,
Arabic, and other less important languages.

It appears to me that the knowledge of so many
languages in an important international city such as Shanghai, is
an enormous advantage to any of your departments when dealing legal
matters, for speaking without understanding both litigants when
defending their cause, is slow and unsatisfactory.

I shall appreciate if you will be good enough to
circulate my application to your other departments that may
require my services in the future and oblige.

+ Italian

Yours very truly,
J. Sanft

阿尔伯特王路 375 号，
King Albert 公寓 5 室
上海，1937 年 2 月 15 日

上海公共租界工部局，
警务处，
上海。

诸位先生：

作为一名在上海商界生活了 36 年的体面居民，凭借无可置疑的推荐信，鉴于当前局势的变化以及合格翻译人员可能出现的现有或未来职位空缺，我谨提交申请，恳请贵方考虑录用我担任此类职位，全职或兼职均可。

我能流利使用八种主要语言，即：西班牙语、英语、法语、德语、希腊语、土耳其语、俄语、阿拉伯语，以及其他次要语言。

在我看来，在上海这样重要的国际都市，掌握如此多的语言对于贵处任何部门在处理法律事务时都是一大优势，因为如果在为当事人辩护时只说话而不理解双方当事人的意思，既缓慢又令人不满。

如蒙贵方惠允将我的申请转呈给其他未来可能需要我服务的部门，本人将不胜感激。

+ 意大利语

此致
敬礼，
J. Sanft
